objects.original: A finite set of natural exponents and arbitrary real coefficients define a polynomial by summing the supported monomials.
objects.reconstructed: For every finite set S ⊆ ℕ and coefficient function a : ℕ → ℝ, define the finite power series P_{S,a} : ℝ → ℝ by P_{S,a}(u) = ∑_{j ∈ S} a(j)u^j.
